verdict.rationale: Testing against a sandbox is a fair question for a cloud robotics fleet platform with admin APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, staging or test environment, nor any dry-run mode. The reference notes indicate the API 'Try It!' runner executes against the production api.formant.io host and that no test environment exists to point it at.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
